_doc: Revert-verify mutants for RFC 14217015 P1.3 (req ebbe3db4, scenario S8): VaultRDFIndexer.wasReifiedStatement recognises a reified statement by the file's exo:Statement_subject triple, so a SUBCLASS statement (typed by its own class, never exo#Statement) is routed to a full refresh and its stale materialized edge is purged. `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header (§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders (§A145).
